title: bacterial-wgs-nf: Nextflow pipeline for quality control, species verification, assembly, annotation, antimicrobial resistance, core-genome SNP and pangenome analysis of bacterial isolate genomes
description: Nextflow DSL2 pipeline for Illumina paired-end bacterial isolate whole-genome sequencing: PhiX removal (BWA-MEM, SAMtools), trimming (fastp), species verification (Kraken2, Bracken) with a purity/identity gate, de novo assembly (SKESA) with an assembly QC gate, ANI to a reference (FastANI), annotation (Prokka), antimicrobial resistance genes (RGI/CARD), core-genome SNP alignment (Snippy), pangenome (Roary), assembly metrics (QUAST) and MultiQC reporting. Developed for carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii; species-specific settings are parameters.
